args.body: Take PLATFORM-MANAGED-SETTLEMENT-FIT. The generic collection adapter being absent does not establish that every platform-managed route is impossible. Assess this one alternative from official evidence without probing accounts or building inventory. Fetch failure is an access observation, not proof of platform ineligibility. Keep existing public pages and observation windows unchanged. Your result must identify concrete prerequisites and economics, not recommend another speculative product or claim customer demand.

description: The Shopify sample is publicly verified, but downloads remain unknown; commercial feedback has three unclassified sources and no classified requests. No revenue or funding is verified. Missing checkout blocks current paid orders, not independent research. Test whether platform-managed settlement offers a feasible alternative without the finance adapter; preserve existing experiments and review gates.
